//: Sample Claude Desktop configuration for the Bellu Graph Engine MCP server (ADR 0011). Copy the 'bellugraph' entry into your claude_desktop_config.json (mcpServers), replacing the absolute paths. Claude Desktop launches bellugraph-server as a subprocess and speaks MCP over stdio; --mcp-stdio disables the HTTP and OTLP servers so the process is a pure local MCP server reading the given data directory.
